thread:
monitoring-bot: :rotating_light: High traffic spike on /v1/generate from multiple regions. 16.8k rps peak, error rate 5xx up to 7.9%. dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/ingress/spike-1765554321

ops-oncall: I'm triaging. applying global throttle for unauthenticated ingress, will open exception list for verified customers.

sanjay: Source IP churn is very high (~28k uniques last 10m). ASNs are diverse; looks like rotating proxy network.

elaine: Suggested action: push WAF rule to block requests missing session cookie + suspicious UA patterns. Add geo-based soft-throttle for noisy ASNs.

kristin: Any impact on paying customers? acme-corp reported timeouts on streaming.

ops-oncall: Creating per-api-key QPS guarantees: verified keys allowed 50rps, others get 429. Applying now.

sanjay: WAF rule sketch:
```
match request.path == "/v1/generate" and not request.cookies.session_id and user_agent =~ /curl|bot|scan/i => block
if client.asn in [39732, 12345] and request.rate > 80rps => throttle 5rps
```

deploy-bot: rolling out edge-waf-rule-1765554321 canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%

monitoring-bot: after deploy inbound RPS down ~60%, 5xx back to 0.6%. keeping watch.

elaine: Logging: add audit entry iam-change-907 for the emergency WAF edit. Propose new RBAC group `waf_admins` and require dual-approve for emergency rule flips.

sanjay: Capturing logs and pcap to s3://incidents/1765554321/, encrypting with arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01. Retain 90d per policy.

kristin: Draft customer blurb: "We observed abusive automated traffic impacting API latency. We applied targeted edge protections. No data exfiltration detected. Protections will remain for 24 hours while we validate." Posting to status shortly.

ops-oncall: Created INC-176555 (sev-2). Owners: sanjay (containment), elaine (sec), kristin (comms). Attachments: logs + timeline.

elaine: Follow-ups: RBAC change PR, KMS key usage audit, add ASN blocklist automation in runbook, unit test harness for WAF rules.

sales-ops: @kristin CS needs a 1-liner for customers worried about safety.

kristin: 1-liner: "Your data and models remain secure; mitigation targeted at abusive traffic only." Sharing with CS now.

sanjay: Leaving temp rules 24h, then review. Opened TICKET-8921 to tune default rate limits and blacklist heuristics.

deploy-bot: note: canary rollback triggered at 18:22 UTC due to misconfig, auto-fixed. No customer regressions.

ops-oncall: Monitoring for 12h, will escalate if recurrence. Recommend postmortem + actions (RBAC, KMS audit, runbook + ASN automation). assigning owners and due dates.

sanjay: Forwarding indicators (UA patterns, top IPs, ASN list) to threat-intel channel. ack.
